data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis): Specify mock stdout and slot file behavior. The mock llm-api-call.sh must write its output to stdout (not to a file argument). For deep-tier specialist calls, the runner redirects stdout to slot files (e.g., > "$_SLOT_CORRECTNESS" &). The mock must honor this: writing a valid findings JSON to stdout is sufficient. Tests that verify slot-file contents should invoke the runner and then read the slot file directly — the mock does not need to know about slot files.
